summary_md:
# “Allt kommer handla om exporten”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opens on a weak note after Wall Street declines, bank-sector IT disruptions and cyberattack fears. Most of the talk is about Nvidia's report ahead of tighter US export rules on chip rentals to China and the fallout from the Jensen Huang scandal. The hosts weigh signs of a market top (BlackRock's private-asset ETF, Anthropic's IPO valuation, Morgan Stanley's maximum overweight, high Costco and Walmart P/E ratios) against signs that we are not at the top (low P/E for Nvidia, SK Hynix and Google). Nordic news covers Nibe's report, where expectations are high on rising German heat-pump subsidy applications, an ABG downgrade of Skistar, and Sinch confirming its CEO.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NIBE-B — Nibe | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Expectations of a good report: German heat-pump subsidy applications have risen, pointing to better growth and margin.

#### Reasoning

The hosts cite market expectations, not their own call, that Nibe's report will show better growth and margin, backed by rising German heat-pump subsidy applications. This is a short-term catalyst around the report today; outcome versus expectations decides the move.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report misses on growth or margin
- if German subsidy demand does not convert to orders

> *"Nibe tror man att det kommer att vara en ganska bra rapport. Man har sett att subventionsansökningarna för värmepumpar i Tyskland har ökat."*

---

### 🟡 SKIS-B — Skistar | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

ABG downgraded to hold; Handelsbanken also cut its recommendation recently.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: two brokers (ABG, Handelsbanken) have cut their recommendations on Skistar within days. Momentum in sell-side sentiment is negative and the explicit rating is hold. The reasons were not discussed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow
- if season bookings weaken

> *"ABG har sänkt Skistar till behåll. De fick en sänkt rek även från Handelsbanken häromdagen."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Report tonight overshadowed by tighter China export rules, CEO scandal and possible export violations; valuation P/E 11 seen as not stretched.

#### Reasoning

The hosts' own view is mixed. They see headwinds from tighter US export rules closing the rental loophole to China, an investigation into possible serious export violations with fines, and governance turmoil after the CEO was ousted. On the other side, they note a low P/E of about 11. Focus is on what CFO Colette Kress says about exports.

#### Sell Triggers

- if export restrictions materially cut China revenue
- if the investigation leads to large fines or charges
- if guidance disappoints

> *"Men jag tror att allt kommer att handla om exporten."*

---

### ⛔ COST — Costco | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

P/E 48 for a low-growth discount retailer, called a top signal.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say Costco's valuation (P/E 48 this year, 44 next year) has run away given low growth prospects, and they cite it as a market-top signal. This is not an explicit trade call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth accelerates enough to justify the multiple

> *"Costco handlas för närvarande till P48. Sjunker till P44 nästa år."*
